subject: open manhole
text: In Chapter 4, after the scene at the museum, there is another open manhole to the left where there is a big heart.

evidence.quote:
In Chapter 4, after the scene at the museum, there is another
open manhole to the left where there is a big heart.

subject: open manhole
text: Head downwards until you see an open manhole, and head inside to Sewer, Part I.

evidence.quote:
Head downwards until you see an open manhole.  That's right, head inside to the...

SEWER, PART I

subject: switch
text: Jump on the raft and onto the switch on the top right corner of the screen, then get the funky orb and head out.

evidence.quote:
Jump on the raft and onto the switch on the top right 
corner of the screen.  Get the funky orb and head out.

subject: Jellyfish
text: Kill the Jellyfish if they get in your way, and head to the right into the open doorway.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Jellyfish if they get in 
your way, but head to the right, into the open doorway.

subject: switch
text: Kill the monkeys on the platforms, where a switch hidden on the tile second from the top on the left side will open a passageway to a room with giant rats.

evidence.quote:
Kill the monkeys on the platforms in here.  There is a switch 
hidden on the tile second from the top on the left side.  It'll open a passageway to a room 
with giant rats.

subject: giant rats
text: Kill off the giant rats to get the medicine.

evidence.quote: Kill them off and get the medicine.

subject: top right tile
text: Make your way South and into a previous room, hit the top right tile, and head out the open doorway to the left.

evidence.quote:
Make your South and 
into a previous room.  Hit the top right tile and head out the open doorway to the left.

subject: monkeys and jellyfish
text: Follow the pathway to the open doorway across from you while watching out for rats, then kill the monkeys and the jellyfish to open the door.

evidence.quote:
Follow the annoying pathway to the open doorway across from you (watch out for rats).  Kill 
the monkeys and the jellyfish to open the door, but especially watch out for the bottom 
monkey, he'll probably hit you when you get in.

subject: owls
text: To kill the owls, jump to hit them or be on higher ground; defeat all three and the door will open.

evidence.quote:
To kill the owls, you have to jump to hit 
them, or be on higher ground.  Get all three and the door will open.

subject: Zoda's Creature
text: After the boss, follow behind Zoda into Sewer, Part II.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you get out, you'll see Zoda slithering away (okay, I'm aware that he doesn't 
slither, but it's a good word).  Follow behind into...

SEWER, PART II

subject: Sewer, Part II
text: Get the hearts to your left and right upon entering Sewer, Part II.

evidence.quote:
Get the hearts to 
your left and right, you'll need them for this dungeon.

subject: switch
text: Kill the larva dudes and the door opens, and get the chest; the switch is third from the right in that column.

evidence.quote:
Kill the larva dudes and the door opens, but don't forget the chest.  The switch 
is third from the right, somewhere in that column.

subject: giant rats
text: Beat both giant rats and head out the door.

evidence.quote:
Oh great, now it's required that you fight 
giant rats.  Beat them both and head out the door.

subject: switch
text: Kill all the enemies to open a secret medicine room, where the switch is on the middle left tile.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the enemies, it'll open a secret 
medicine room, which will probably be helpful after all those rats.  The switch is where it 
always is, the middle left tile.

subject: raft
text: Head back into the other room, hit the switch to get out, and follow the rafts and platforms across.

evidence.quote: Head back into the other room, and don't worry about the enemies.  Hit the switch and get out.  Follow the rafts and platforms across, it's pretty straight forward.

subject: middle set of tiles
text: Kill the blobs and move on to find a hidden switch on the left of the middle set of tiles, grab the medicine, and step into the right set of tiles.

evidence.quote:
Kill the blobs and move on.  The middle set of tiles will have 
a switch hidden on the left.  Make sure not to go inbetween the tiles yet.  Grab yet another 
medicine, and step into the right set of tiles.

subject: doorway
text: Head through the door and nab the medicine, then head out and up the stairs at the top.

evidence.quote:
Head through the door and nab the medicine, 
then head out and up the stairs at the top.

subject: middle set of tiles
text: Take the middle set of tiles, head down to eliminate the rats to open a doorway on the right, and get rid of the green things to reach the half-way point in the dungeon.

evidence.quote:
Now take the middle set of tiles.  Head down, 
and cheer, for there are more rats.  Get rid of them, and a doorway will open on the right.  
Once you get rid of the green things, you'll reach the "half-way" point in the dungeon.

subject: half-way point
text: You restart at the half-way point every time you die, and the Try-Your-Luck Sign is fairly close to the boss.

evidence.quote:
You'll restart here every time you die, and it's fairly close to the boss, so the Try-Your-
Luck Sign will basically give you unlimited tries.

subject: upper middle tile
text: Grab the hearts and the sign, jump from raft to raft onto the tiles, hit the switch in the upper middle tile, and grab the discs.

evidence.quote:
Grab the hearts and the sign, and jump 
from raft to raft, onto the tiles.  The switch is in the upper middle tile.  Grab the discs 
and jump onto the platform when you see the raft coming.  The platform will disappear, so 
don't stand there waiting to die.

subject: secret room
text: Kill the larva to open another secret, grab the medicine, and head back to the other room.

evidence.quote:
Kill the larva to open another secret.  Grab the medicine (you should have about 3 now, all 
which will be needed), and head back to the other room.

subject: switch
text: There is a switch in the bottom right, but get rid of the larvae first to avoid serious damage.

evidence.quote:
There's a switch in the bottom 
right, but I suggest you get rid of the larvae first, or you'll probably take serious damage.

subject: Zoda
text: After reaching and defeating Zoda, you obtain the Tetrad, increasing your life level.

evidence.quote:
And now you've finally reached Zoda.  See the Boss section for info.

Not much walking till you get the Tetrad...

_***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***_

subject: Mike
text: Saying the magic words Paa paa paa oom papa mow mow into the Oxford Wonder World slips you to Chapter V - Gold Rush.

evidence.quote:
_*You decide to use the Oxford Wonder World again*_
_*You turn the page and say the magic words...*_
_Paa paa paa oom papa mow mow_
_Whooaaa!  This is radical!_

.............You slip to another time and space...


	e) Chapter V - Gold Rush

subject: Bob's Store
text: Talk to everyone outside in town, in the top shop, the hidden guy behind a house, and in the saloon, then visit Bob's Store near the entrance to receive a free pack of dynamite.

evidence.quote:
Walk north till you find something that looks like a pile of garbage.  It's a town.  Talk to 
everybody outside, then head into the shop at the top of the screen.  Talk to the guy, then 
head out.  Now go to the right and around a house, and you'll see another guy that's sort of 
hidden there.  Talk to him too.  After you're finished with that, go into the saloon.  Talk 
to everyone there, and listen to the piano player's horrible song.  Once you've talked to 
everyone, go into Bob's Store, it'll be near the entrance to the town.  He'll give you a free 
pack of dynamite!

subject: West wall
text: Place the dynamite on the West wall of the mountain between the two rocks near the bottom to explode the wall and enter to get a Big Heart.

evidence.quote:
Go outside and run up to the West wall, in the mountain.  Place the 
dynamite inbetween the two rocks near the bottom (to place it, just walk up to the wall).  
The wall will explode, and walk inside to get a Big Heart.

subject: lower light-colored pathway
text: In Chapter 5, before entering any tunnels, placing a pack of dynamite at the end of the lower light-colored pathway yields a gold nugget that can be taken back to the store for extra points.

evidence.quote:
In Chapter 5, before you enter any of the tunnels, if you
place a pack of dynamite at the end of the lower light-colored
pathway, you will get a gold nugget that can be taken back to
the store for some extra points.

subject: lower lighter pathway
text: Place dynamite 3 squares down from the lower lighter pathway at the side of the mountain and walk forward to enter Gold Cave.

evidence.quote:
Notice the two lighter pathways at the side of the mountain?  
Place the dynamite 3 squares down from the lower one....Walk forward and you'll get into...

GOLD CAVE

subject: boulder
text: Destroy the boulder on the wall to open up a passageway, then go up the stairs and head right avoiding rolling boulders.

evidence.quote: Forget these enemies, destroy the boulder on the wall and a passageway will open up.  Go up the stairs, and avoid the rolling boulders while heading right.

subject: tiles
text: Get rid of the snakes, grab some hearts hidden in some of the tiles, then jump onto the middle platform to fall through into another room.

evidence.quote:
Ouch, snakes.  Get rid of them, and grab 
some hearts hidden in some of those tiles.  Now, jump in the platform in the middle, and 
you'll fall through into another room.

subject: real chest
text: Kill the cobras and scorpions and hit the switch; in the next room, attack chest monsters with the shockwave and grab the bola from the real chest.

evidence.quote:
Kill the cobras and scorpions, and hit the switch.  In the next room, be sure to attack the 
chest monsters with the shockwave, or you'll be in for a lot of pain.  Grab the bola in the 
real chest, and kill the enemies in the next room.

subject: secret door
text: Killing the enemies opens a secret door containing medicine.

evidence.quote:
A secret door will open up, and you'll 
get some medicine.

subject: donkey
text: Walk forward and talk to the donkey after the boss to obtain the Super Psychic Shockwave.

evidence.quote:
Walk forward and talk to the donkey.  No, that isn't a typo.  I think it's a donkey, anyway.  
Congrats, you got the Super Psychic Shockwave!  You'll need it for the next dungeon...

subject: start room switch
text: In the start room, hit the tile switch in the bottom right corner to get some hearts.

evidence.quote:
In the start room, many people fail to see the tile switch in the bottom right corner.  Get 
it for some hearts.

subject: scorpions
text: Keep your distance and use the Super Psychic Shockwave while jumping to hit the scorpions.

evidence.quote:
In the next room, keep your distance and use the Super Psychic Shockwave 
while jumping to hit the scorpions.

subject: conveyer belt room
text: Upon entering the fast moving conveyer belt room, jump off to the right to get medicine, then jump back on and jump off at the third room.

evidence.quote:
Now be ready for the next room, as soon as you go 
through the door you'll get on a fast moving conveyer belt.  As soon as you get in the next 
room, jump off to the right, and get the medicine.  Now jump back on, and jump off at the 
third room you see on the conveyer belt.

subject: wall opening
text: Kill the scorpions to open the wall on the other side, head up past two enemies into the opened wall, and hit the switch near the hearts to grab them and another medicine bottle.

evidence.quote:
Kill the scorpions and a wall should open up on the other side.  Head up (not on the conveyer 
belt), and make your way past the two enemies, killing them won't give you anything.  Head 
around and into the wall you opened.  The switch should be near the hearts, so grab them and 
another medicine bottle.

subject: crack in the wall
text: Destroy the crack in the wall to find a secret area with medicine, make your way past the boulders onto the switch, and get the invincibility star.

evidence.quote:
As soon as you get into the next room, you should see a crack in the wall.  Destroy 
it and find another secret area, with more medicine (believe me, you'll need it).  Make your 
way passed the boulders, onto the switch, and get the invincibility star.

subject: mine cart guy
text: The guy in the mine cart shoots bullets and drops little fire guys; beat him with or without using the invincibility star.

evidence.quote:
The guy in the mine cart will drive buy 
shooting bullets and dropping little fire guys.  I'd suggest trying to beat this guy without 
using the invincibility star, and saving that for the boss.  But if it's too hard for you, 
use the star and kick the crap out of him.

subject: second crack in the wall
text: Kill the cobras to reveal a secret crack in the wall containing medicine, then hit the bottom right corner switch to grab another invincibility star.

evidence.quote:
Don't head out yet, kill the cobras and open another secret.  
There's a secret within this secret, as there's another crack in the wall.  Run in to get 
more medicine.  Now hit the switch, which will be in the bottom right corner, and grab 
another invincibility star.

subject: Gold Cave, Part II
text: Avoid the spikes right up to the boss and head north to obtain a Tetrad, increasing your life level.

evidence.quote:
Now head out, and avoid the spikes right up to the boss.  You 
know where to look.

Blah blah head north yadda yadda get Tetrad something something eat more chicken...

_***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***_

subject: statue stairs
text: In Chapter VI - Italy, walk until you get to a big house with something moving inside the statue, and head down the stairs to Leo's Basement.

evidence.quote:
f) Chapter VI - Italy...Walk around until you get to a big house.  Walk towards the stairs, and you'll find that there's 
something moving inside the statue.  Oh well, head down the stairs to...

LEO'S BASEMENT

subject: rolling balls
text: Knock the rolling balls into the hole with your weapon across two rooms to obtain the hammer and chisel.

evidence.quote:
till you get to a room with a bunch of balls rolling about.  
The point of this game is to knock them into the hole with your weapon.  Do this in two rooms 
and it's all over.

Pretty quick, no?  Grab the hammer and chisel and a "cutscene" will begin...

subject: Leonardo da Vinci
text: Chip away the plaster on the statue using the hammer and chisel to free Leonardo da Vinci, who gives you a Katana.

evidence.quote:
_*You chip away with the hammer and chisel*_
_Ow...get me outta here..._..._*It's the famous artist, Leonardo da Vinci!*_..._Take this weapon, too.  It's a souvenir of Marco Polo's from the far East_
_*You've got a Katana*_

subject: mountain wall
text: When the flying machine stops, walk up to the wall of the mountain from the West to get a Big Heart.

evidence.quote:
What's that?  We're stopping?!  But I 
don't see anything.  Walk up to the wall of the mountain from the West, and you'll get a Big 
Heart.

subject: hole with green guys
text: If you fall into the hole with the green guys, the switch is in the second last column.

evidence.quote:
Go 
down the stairs, and head to the left.  If you fall in the hole with the green guys, the 
switch is in the second last column.  Keep heading left, ignore any other pathways.

subject: stairs pathway
text: After the stairs, walk two squares left, one down, and all the way left until you're under the next stairway, then go up it.

evidence.quote:
After the stairs, walk two squares left, one down, and all the way left until you're under 
the next stairway.  Go up it.

subject: fork
text: At the fork, defeat the red thing, head up, dodge or kill the skulls, go up the stairs, stop over the last set of footprints, and head down one, right two, up one, right two, down one, and all the way right to the Tetrad.

evidence.quote:
Get to the fork and you'll fall into another mini-dungeon.  
Kill the red thing, and head up.  Dodge the skulls (or kill them) and head up the stairs.  
Stop over the last set of footprints, or you'll fall into another dungeon.  Head down one, 
right two, up one, right two, down one, and then all the way right to the Tetrad!

_***You've got a Tetrad!  Your life level is increased!***_

subject: potion room
text: Grab the hearts at the entrance and to the left, take the far right doorway, kill the bats, and grab the potion in the next room.

evidence.quote:
DRACULA'S CASTLE

Grab the hearts, and then go the left, and grab those hearts.  Now go back to the right, and 
take the far right doorway.  Kill the bats, and grab the potion in the next room.

subject: secret room
text: Wait for the ghosts to appear, kill the main one, and enter the secret room to grab medicine while watching out for the fire around it.

evidence.quote:
Wait for the ghosts to appear, and kill the main one.  Go into the secret room and grab the 
medicine, but watch out for the fire around it.

subject: walking dudes
text: Kill the main ghost to the right, enter the pathway, and get rid of the walking dudes with the shockwave.

evidence.quote:
Go back out and two the right, and kill the 
main ghost.  Head in the pathway, and get rid of the walking dudes with the shockwave.

subject: tombstone guy
text: Get rid of the tombstone guy by attacking the tombstone, and go into the next room.

evidence.quote:
Get 
rid of the tombstone guy buy attacking the tombstone, and go into the next room.

subject: falling hole
text: Jump to the chest, fall in the hole while heading diagonally left or right to grab the sign, and head to the left to the tip of the arrow for medicine.

evidence.quote:
Jump to the 
chest, and wait a moment.  As soon as you fall in that hole, head diagnally left or right.  
Grab the sign, and go to the right.  If you want a medicine, and are willing to go in circles 
for a moment, go to the left, and go to the tip of the arrow.

subject: door
text: Kill all the enemies in the next room, and a door will open up.

evidence.quote:
Kill all the enemies in the next 
room, and a door will open up.
